units.notes: The public notice of January 2023 confirms five identical gas engines with a total fuel heat input of 139.3 MW thermal. That matches the earlier batch, which found 62.6 MW electric from the permit itself, so nothing is staged again. No engine maker or start date appears in the notice.

The permit register holds only the engine plant procedure. I found no permit procedure for the 800 MW combined cycle plant, so the earlier batch's findings from the Bavarian ministry press release of May 2026 stand.
